title: Approvals: right after approving, an approver with no standing access sees 「未找到记录」 on the record they just decided
body:
Filing gate: ① user-visible defect, measured in the browser on @objectstack 18.2.0 (hotclm `main` c53d37d, `pnpm demo`, zh-CN console, README-made personas).

**Symptom.** In 18.2.0, #26180 gives the person a pending approval step waits on a read-only view of the record, and revokes it when the step ends. That works. But the approver decides from the record page itself (通过 / 拒绝 above the record). Right after the decision, the same URL re-reads the record, and the page says:

> 未找到记录 · 您查找的记录不存在或已被删除

This appears directly under the 「已通过」 toast. The record exists; only the approver's read ended. A rung-1 manager who holds no position sees it after every approval or rejection.

**Measured** (hotclm #134, os-dev-report https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotclm/issues/134#issuecomment-6437960158). The approver is Line Manager 1, who has no position. After 通过 on ORD-2026-0017:
- the page reads 「未找到记录」;
- `GET /clm_contract/<id>` returns 404;
- the child lists return n=0;
- the version file returns `403 FILE_DOWNLOAD_DENIED`.

After 拒绝 on NDA-2026-0021 the result is the same.

**Expected.** After a decision that ends the approver's read, the console does not show the deleted-record page. It takes the approver back to where they came from (待我处理 / the approval inbox), or shows a message saying the decision was recorded and the record is no longer shared with them.

**Business reason.** Every approver without standing access to the record (the commonest case is a direct manager) is told, right after approving, that the contract they just approved does not exist.

**Reader.** platform triage: console record page and approvals, `ui/`.

**Consumer.** objectstack-ai/hotclm. Its README documents the wording as a known platform behaviour (PR #164).

**Duplicate search.** objectstack issues, all states: "approver record not found after approve", "pending approver read revoked", "未找到记录 after approve". No match. Related but closed: #26180 (the read itself) and #25934 (inline edit under lock).
